_comment: Qwen3.5-9B geometry on a 3 nm-class die with one HBM stack per layer ASIC. Fabric at 2 GHz (extrapolated beyond the ASAP7 signoff): 4 passes x 2048 cycles = 4.1 us per layer, 1.0 us per head die; global compute phases scaled by the same clock ratio, and the index-scan compute by the 4x fewer compressed positions as well. int4 KV at 16:1 compression, 1.5 TB/s per die, 256 resident contexts, a 16 GB/s ring link, 0.5 pJ per MAC, and 30 pJ per byte for HBM. A layer admits a token every pass rather than every layer (layer_pass_cycles). Each recurrent layer reads and writes its 512 KB Gated DeltaNet state through the local memory every token, and all stages of a die share one memory interface.
